# `current_path`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the current SQL path (qualified schema names).

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.2 and later.

## Syntax

```text
current_path()
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `misc_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- current_path, example 1
> SELECT current_path();
system.builtin,system.session,spark_catalog.default
```
